title: Bukidnon starts sugar milling season amid high production costs

blocks.text: MARAMAG, Bukidnon — Trucks laden with freshly cut sugarcane filled the industrial yards of Bukidnon’s major milling plants on Monday, marking the official opening of the 2026–2027 sugarcane milling season amid soaring production costs. Bukidnon’s milling season commenced roughly a month after operations opened on Negros Island on October 1. Before the official rollout, stakeholder groups engaged in pre-milling activities, including a mass on November 6 and the start of raw cane acceptance for loaded and non-regulated containers on November 7.
